compile_pipeline: resolve stable field IDs and representation IDs
validate entity scope and support unit
validate temporal semantics, observable time, maturity and revision policy
validate operator family against route allowlist
emit candidate-field lineage and exposure-ledger records
fail closed on unresolved or contradictory semantics

rejection_codes.UNKNOWN_FIELD_ID: field cannot be resolved to the capability registry
rejection_codes.SOURCE_FIELD_ID_PENDING: provisional field lacks final source-universe identity
rejection_codes.ENTITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH: operator assumes a different entity scope
rejection_codes.MARKET_FIELD_DIRECT_CSRANK: market-level state would be constant across stocks
rejection_codes.ROUTE_OPERATOR_FORBIDDEN: operator family is not legal for the route
rejection_codes.LATCHED_AS_LIFECYCLE: latched observation used as enter/exit lifecycle state
rejection_codes.INTRABAR_ORDER_FABRICATED: 1-minute OHLC used to invent within-bar event order
rejection_codes.POST_WINDOW_NOT_MATURE: post-event feature used before its window matures
rejection_codes.EPISODE_REPEAT_VOTE: one episode contributes repeated minute-level votes
rejection_codes.EXPOSURE_LEDGER_MISSING: candidate cannot emit lineage and stage exposure records
rejection_codes.SEALED_DATA_ACCESS: candidate or compiler requests forbidden data

required_negative_tests: market regime field rejected by direct CSRank
interaction-only legacy label cannot bypass typed route
latched observation rejected as lifecycle exit/reseal source
post-event signal masked until maturity time
future revision hidden before revision observable time
candidate without stable field lineage rejected
